**v1.14.5: after Wizard101's November patch the bot reads your cards from the game's memory again, knows your health every round (so it drinks potions instead of walking from knockout to knockout), learns look-alike cards such as Balanceblade and Bladestorm apart, stops walking into mobs it shouldn't fight, and learns again how far mobs see you.**

- **Fixed: "the cards can't be read in this build" since Wizard101's patch (game build 6AFBB954-37B4000, around 2026-11-18).**
  - **What was wrong:** the bot finds the game's classes by their names in the game's code. After the patch, the name the card reader needs ("CombatPlanningPhaseWindow") sits right after two other bytes instead of on its own, and the bot skipped it. Every start then failed to build the card reader (vision\vision.log said so; debug.log didn't): your hand, your pips, the backpack, the decks, the gear and the game's UI size went unread, and battles fell back to finding cards by their pictures - right after a reinstall, with no cards learned yet, the bot passed every round.
  - **Now:** when a name isn't found on its own, the bot also accepts a copy that the game's code really loads. Every class it found before is found exactly as before.
- **Fixed: your health was never read when your name plate isn't found by its picture (UI scale 0.856 - 1920 wide), so no potions and a knockout loop.**
  - **What was wrong:** the game's memory had your health every round, but the bot only asked for it when your plate was found on screen. So the potion check never learned your most health, counted you at 100% and never drank, and after a knockout the bot walked straight into the next battle (5 knockouts in 9 minutes on 2026-11-21).
  - **Now:** your health is read every round, from the game's memory first and your plate when it's found; the enemy-danger check uses it too. After a drink that took, the bot drinks again (3 at most) while still under your potion limit, stopping if you start playing, a battle starts or the bot is turned off. A health globe it can't read just after a knockout counts as 1 health. Heals and Tower Shield still need your plate (they click it), and a party healer no longer holds an ally's heal for one of yours that can't go.
- **Fixed: look-alike cards (Balanceblade and Bladestorm) learned as one.**
  - **What was wrong:** the two blades' pictures are mostly the same white disc, so a Bladestorm was taken for a copy of the Balanceblade beside it and never learned; from then on every Bladestorm was named Balanceblade and its blade often went uncast.
  - **Now:** while the game's hand is read, a copy is told by the game's card names. A box whose picture names another card, where the game has its own card, is learned as the card it is (once - no duplicate of a card already learned).
- **Fixed: the bot walked into mobs after a knockout - a "Defeat ..." goal in another zone was fought for where the wizard stood.**
  - **What was wrong:** with the quest arrow hidden for 2 seconds (the wizard coming back from a knockout), the walker took a "Defeat Shaka Zebu in Zamunda" goal for one the game shows no way to and started collecting it - walking into every mob on purpose, with mob avoidance off - two zones away from Zamunda. After each battle it carried on ("same goal as before"): knockout after knockout.
  - **Now:** a "Defeat ..." goal isn't collected while the game's memory has a place for it - in another zone, or here (where the arrow leads, as before). Collecting one the memory has in another zone stops and walks the way there.
- **Fixed: just into a new zone, the bot walked before it knew where the zone's mobs were.**
  - **What was wrong:** the vision helper looks for a zone's mobs in the game's memory every few seconds (a look takes 2-5 seconds) and the mobs appear after the loading screen, so for the first seconds in a zone the route had no mobs in it. An Impi Raider caught the wizard at 3 of 4 entries into Zamunda.
  - **Now:** after a loading screen (or a relog), with mob avoidance on, the wizard waits until the helper has looked at the new zone's mobs - about 2-5 seconds, 8 at most - then walks on round them. A walk through a way out ends at the new zone's loading screen, as before: the wait doesn't carry it on into the zone, short of the goal.
- **Fixed: a "Collect ..." or "Use ..." goal the game shows no way to sat at NEEDS YOU "No quest arrow" at UI scale 0.856.**
  - **What was wrong:** for such a goal the bot finds the things to use in the game's memory, but only while the goal's line shows on screen too (so an old goal isn't followed). At this UI size the game's outlined quest text reads as garble at any zoom, so the line never seemed to be there: "Collect Pegasus Chow in Pegasus Place (0 of 5)" waited for 3 hours on 2026-11-22, and "Use Strange Plant (0 of 3)" the same.
  - **Now:** the count at the line's end ("of 5)") comes through the garble and counts as the line being there. And after X at someone, a dialogue that hands out such a goal no longer leaves the walker waiting for the next one (until a battle, or until you touched the keyboard): it starts collecting.
- **Fixed: the knockout guard (3 knockouts at one quest goal stops walking) didn't count a goal's knockouts together.** A knockout while the goal line was blank (a battle, a loading screen) was counted under "somewhere in <zone>" instead of the goal; now under the last goal line read.
- **Fixed: an error box "Expected a Number but got an empty string" at a round's start.** A timer added in v1.14.4 (Wizard101 at High priority) could write to the log in the moment between the bot's Pass-button search and its check of it, so a Pass button that wasn't there was taken as found. Every timer, menu item, hotkey and window event now keeps the bot's search results to itself (a new test checks all of them), and a Pass "found" with no position isn't one.
- **Fixed: every round passed when Wizard101's Resolution setting is bigger than your screen.** With the game set to 1920x1200 on a 1920x1080 screen (a remote desktop session changing size, say) the game draws at 1920x1080 but its window stays 1920x1200 tall; the bot looked for your cards 60 pixels too low and found none. A full-screen game window bigger than its screen is now measured as the part on the screen, and the log says what fixes it (setting the game's Resolution to your screen's size).
- **Fixed: the bot never learned how far mobs see you from being caught - the mob reach it keeps out of (mobgrow) only ever grew when you raised it.**
  - **What was wrong:** at a battle's first round the bot asks which mob started it. The helper took the mob nearest the wizard in its last reading - but the walker reads on until that first round, and by then the game has walked the wizard and the mobs onto the duel circle's sigils, about 1150 apart. On 2026-11-21 not one of 16 catches was taken.
  - **Now:** the game's log says when the battle formed ("MSG_Duel received", written the moment the mob and the wizard meet) and which mobs are in it. The helper uses only its readings from before that second, picks the nearest of the battle's mobs, and follows its run back to where it set off (not its own walk on its rounds). debug.log says "Caught by ..." or why not ("Caught: who started the battle not known - ..."). One catch raises the reach by 200 at most, and by 20 when you walked into the mob. Not counted: a battle another wizard was already in, one whose start isn't in the log, one you were playing around, a dungeon run's, and the quest's own (a battle with the quest's mob in it).
- **Fixed: the mobs' reach shrank while the wizard stood still.** It's made a tenth smaller after 10 minutes of walking without a catch (mobshrink), but "walking" was the walker being switched on: 8 of those 10 minutes were spent standing at a NEEDS YOU on 2026-11-22 (980 -> 882), and overnight with the game closed it shrank the same. Now it counts only while the bot holds W to walk.
- **Also:** starting the bot while a full-screen Wizard101 is minimized no longer picks the wrong picture size (a minimized window read as 160x28); when the window comes back at a size it was played at before (generated\scales.txt), that size's pictures are used.
- **Checked:** against the running game (reading only): the card reader builds again and every other class reads as before; the bot played from the game's memory on 2026-11-21 (health read every round, Power Nova and the blades cast by the game's card boxes, the knockout guard stopping at the 3rd knockout). Each fix has tests of its own (each fails on the old code), and each went through a review with skeptics (the confirmed findings fixed). The five release scripts load. 922 of 961 vision tests pass (38 are skipped on this PC). `test_ahk_names`' speedhack path test errors, as on v1.12.0. Seen in the game on 2026-11-22: the wait for a new zone's mobs (18 holds, 1.8-4.1 s after each loading screen), and walks through ways out ending at the loading screen (a talk quest round Pigswick Academy's shops, 6 ways out in 2 minutes). Catches taken: "Caught by Wood Goblin, standing: you walked into it (338 away)", and a recorder of the game's log agreed (the goblin 332 away just before the battle formed, the wizard and the mobs 1141-1200 apart on the duel circle after); 10 more catches by Wood Goblins and Hobgoblins, 2 battles not known. The Pegasus Chow goal with no arrow was taken up and counted 3 -> 4 of 5.
- **Updating:** the updater offers this to every install. Your settings, learned cards, routes and recorded battles are kept. A copy run from the code: git pull.
